chunks: My father (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Ahmad ibn Idris narrated to us. He said: Ibrahim ibn Hashim narrated to us, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub. He said: Ali ibn Ri'ab narrated to us. He said: Musa ibn Bakr narrated to us, from Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far, from his father, from his forefathers (peace be upon them). He said: The Messenger of God (may God's blessings be upon him and his family) said:
Do not belittle the poor among the Shi'a of Ali and his progeny after him, for surely a man from among them will intercede for the like of [the tribes of] Rabi'a and Mudar.

key_terms.تستخفوا: To belittle, take lightly, or show contempt toward someone
key_terms.ربيعة ومضر: Rabi'a and Mudar, two of the largest and most prominent Arab tribal confederations, used here to denote a vast multitude of people
key_terms.شيعة: Shi'a, meaning followers or partisans, here referring to the devoted followers of Imam Ali (AS)
key_terms.عترته: His progeny/household (itrah), referring to the Ahl al-Bayt
key_terms.يشفع: To intercede (shafa'ah), to plead on behalf of others before God on the Day of Judgment

ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Muhammad say about the intercession of the poor Shi'a of Ali?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) warns against looking down upon the impoverished followers of Imam Ali (AS) and his descendants. He declares that even a single poor Shi'a will have the power of intercession on the Day of Judgment for multitudes comparable to the great Arab tribes of Rabi'a and Mudar. This hadith, narrated through the Imams from Prophet Muhammad, elevates the spiritual station of the poor believers and underscores the Shia doctrine of intercession (shafa'ah) on the Day of Judgment.

en.bilal-muhammad: My father (ra) narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Idris narrated to us. He said: Ibrahim b. Hashim narrated to us from al-Hasan b. Mahbub. He said: `Ali b. Ri’ab narrated to us. He said: Musa b. Bakr narrated to us from Abi’l Hasan Musa b. Ja`far from his father from his forefathers (as). He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:
Do not take the poor of the Shi`a of `Ali and his progeny after him lightly. Surely, a man from them will intercede for the like of Rabi` and Mudar.
